scope: Windows Release backend unit tests; no aircraft connection or native UI validation

change.description: Link DroneBackend_tests only to GTest::gtest. The target supplies its own main and does not use Google Mock.

confirmed_root_cause.symptom: ServerOptionsTest.RejectsInvalidAndOutOfRangePorts raised SEH 0xc0000005 during destruction of the first SCOPED_TRACE.
confirmed_root_cause.mechanism: The former GTest::gtest_main + GTest::gmock link combination split Google Test state between two DLL runtimes. ScopedTrace construction was imported from gtest_main.dll, which depends on gtest.dll, while destruction and UnitTest were imported from gmock.dll, which contains its own Google Test runtime. Trace push and pop therefore accessed different stacks.
confirmed_root_cause.fixed_imports: ScopedTrace constructor, ScopedTrace destructor, InitGoogleTest and UnitTest::GetInstance all import from gtest.dll. The test executable no longer imports gtest_main.dll or gmock.dll.

control_experiments.name: invalid_cli_processes
control_experiments.result: All 20 invalid port cases across --http-port and --ws-port were rejected by the existing backend with exit 1 and the expected validation error; no crash.

control_experiments.name: full_rebuild_before_fix
control_experiments.result: Rebuilding the original test target reproduced the same single SEH failure, excluding a stale object file as the explanation.

control_experiments.name: temporary_trace_diagnostics
control_experiments.result: Both EXPECT_THROW assertions for the first empty value completed before SCOPED_TRACE destruction failed. All temporary diagnostics were removed.

control_experiments.name: same_test_source_gtest_only
control_experiments.result: The original test_server_options.cpp with an independent main and only gtest.lib passed 7/7.

control_experiments.name: same_test_source_mixed_runtime
control_experiments.result: The same original test source and main linked with gtest_main.lib, gmock.lib and gtest.lib reproduced the same SEH failure, with 6/7 passing.

control_experiments.name: fixed_pe_imports
control_experiments.result: PE import inspection confirmed all trace and UnitTest functions resolve to one gtest.dll runtime.

test_isolation.description: Temporary-directory environment overrides applied only to test subprocesses. The test target uses pure logic, callback mocks and temporary persistence; no live aircraft transport implementation is linked.

evidence_policy: Only relative repository paths and sanitized passed-test output are included.
